description: This file defines structures and a class for parsing the PROXY Protocol v2, including handling of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, byte swapping, and parsing logic.

classes.name: ProxyParser
classes.description: A class for parsing PROXY Protocol v2 headers, extracting source addresses, and managing proxy address data.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Returns the source IP address as a string view, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a data buffer to identify and process a PROXY v2 header, returning success status and bytes consumed.
